font.reason: The only visible copy is a bold display title in MaskingTapeSlap. Lalezar supplies comparable impact with naturally joined Persian forms; it is loaded through FaRoot and no synthetic weight is requested. PopupBookRise has no visible glyphs, only abstract placeholder bars.

components.name: MaskingTapeSlap

translation.note: Short, centered motion-demo title; there is no per-character animation or timing dependency.

rtlDecisions.action: Translate, use Lalezar at a Persian-sized scale, retain central anchoring
rtlDecisions.why: The original poster title is centered; reading direction changes the script, not the composition axis.

rtlDecisions.what: Card title and body placeholder bars
rtlDecisions.action: Anchor their unequal lengths to the right in a card-local fixture
rtlDecisions.why: Abstract lines stand for Persian text and must begin at the reading start.

rtlDecisions.what: Card footer avatar and label bar
rtlDecisions.action: Place avatar at the right with the bar immediately to its left
rtlDecisions.why: The footer is a reading-order pair.

rtlDecisions.action: Reflect top-left to top-right and bottom-right to bottom-left
rtlDecisions.why: The taped corners form a reading-direction diagonal around the localized card.

rtlDecisions.action: Negate horizontal approach offsets and reflect the slant and both overshoot offsets
rtlDecisions.why: The full six-frame trajectory must mirror, not merely the resting angle.
Its subtle left-to-right material lighting is part of the reflected tape surface.
The tears are physical texture rather than reading-order information.

rtlDecisions.what: Card floating, sine wobble, downward settling, shadow compression, tape squash
rtlDecisions.action: Keep the original formulas, easing, and frame cues
rtlDecisions.why: These describe physical paper and the two impact beats, not text direction.

components.rasterHandling: No raster or video assets. Tape and cards are CSS shapes; the fixture contains no baked foreign text.
components.motionTiming: Unchanged: float f12-f38, slaps f58/f82, freeze by f84, static hold through f139. The translated title is static and changes no timing beat.

rtlDecisions.what: Scene perspective, rotateX hinge, spring, root shadows and final camera settling
rtlDecisions.action: Keep all signs and numeric values

components.rasterHandling: No raster or video assets and no baked text. The gray bars are abstract fixture geometry.
components.motionTiming: Unchanged: first card starts f14, seven-frame stagger, last starts f49, all settle near f83, camera settles f108, static through f139. There is no text length or per-character timing dependency.

verification.method: Rendered and visually opened original/Persian same-frame PNG pairs where upstream MP4 frames exist; opened Persian entrance, hits, stagger, settling and final frames for both components. Final harness --duration 140 --video completed with ok:true and no render errors for both compositions.

concerns: Upstream MP4s stop at frames 37 and 33, before both major payoffs. Late Persian beats were checked against the source prompt and unchanged source timing formulas; late original video frame pairs do not exist. The harness lists orig paths for those late frames even though FFmpeg did not create the files.

The repository registry durations are still 38/34 frames, so normal registry previews omit the two slap hits and most of the book rise. This card-level task forbids registry edits; the delivered full-length videos use the 140-frame harness override.

lessons.symptom: A mirrored absolute-positioned sidebar still shows its flex-column placeholder rows against its left edge
lessons.cause: RTL direction does not change the cross-axis alignment of a column flex container
lessons.fix: Set alignItems:flex-end after moving the sidebar to the right; verify the projected 3D frame.

lessons.symptom: A reflected tape lands at the correct mirrored angle but travels through the wrong angular anticipation and overshoot
lessons.cause: The approach and overshoot angle offsets retain their original signs
lessons.fix: Reflect the offsets too (rot+16 to rot-7 to rot), while preserving their magnitudes, easing, and frame cues.
